title: Affine-open twist vanishing independent of proper coherence
statement: Let S be Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], f:X -> S proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], F a quasi-coherent coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], and L invertible [def-sc-invertible-module]. Fix an affine open V of S such that L restricted to f inverse-image V is ample [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and assume injective resolutions of X.Modules. There is a natural-number threshold n0 such that for n >= n0 and every q > 0 the restriction to V of R^q f_*(F tensor L^n) [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is zero. This statement fixes one affine open and asserts no uniform threshold over the whole base.

source.place: Tag 02O1, Lemma 30.16.2, affine-local proof; Tag 0B5T (4), with the finite Cech cohomological-degree bound

proof.text: The acyclic local uniform qcqs degree-bound theorem gives a neighborhood and a coefficient-independent bound at each point of the affine base V. Compactness gives a finite subcover; its finite maximum gives a global coefficient-independent degree bound d for the restricted morphism. Apply fixed-degree affine Serre vanishing to the restrictions of F and L in each positive degree below d. Degree zero imposes no condition. Take the sum of these finitely many twist thresholds; this sum dominates each threshold.

For degrees at least the bound, use the coefficient-independent higher-direct-image bound just constructed. In the remaining positive degrees compare module cohomology with source H and affine sections of the higher direct image. Quasi-coherence follows from the qcqs higher-image theorem. Restrict the higher image along the affine base isomorphism to Spec of its global sections; the tilde counit shows it is zero because its global sections are zero. Restrict back along the inverse isomorphism.
The ordinary higher-direct-image open-restriction isomorphism transports this vanishing to the original higher image restricted to V.

proof_origin.place: Affine-local vanishing; fixed-degree thresholds combined using finite support
proof_origin.note: E4 reduction: one fixed-degree cohomology hole; the finite maximum, affine zero detection and ordinary open restriction are proved in Lean. The original CoherentSerreVanishing import is cyclic.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_isZero_higherDirectImage_twist_on_affine_open
    {X S : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian S] (f : X ⟶ S) [IsProper f]
    (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (V : S.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (hL : ∃ h : (L.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι).IsInvertible,
      @IsAmple (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme (L.restrict (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).ι) h)
    [HasInjectiveResolutions X.Modules] :
    ∃ n₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, n₀ ≤ n → ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q →
      IsZero (((higherDirectImage f q).obj (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n)).restrict V.ι)
